title: Enable NAT with nftables for internet sharing
summary: Configure nftables to perform Network Address Translation (NAT) and allow forwarding of traffic from the client interface to the internet interface.
prerequisites: Static IP is set on the client interface

steps.explain: Create a new table named 'nat' in the inet family.
steps.cmd: sudo nft add table inet nat

steps.explain: Create a postrouting chain in the nat table for source NAT.
steps.cmd: sudo nft add chain inet nat postrouting '{ type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat ; }'

steps.explain: Add a rule to masquerade traffic leaving via the internet interface.
steps.cmd: sudo nft add rule inet nat postrouting oifname <INTERNET_INTERFACE> masquerade

placeholders.name: INTERNET_INTERFACE
placeholders.description: Name of the interface connected to the internet

steps.explain: Allow forwarding of established and related connections in the filter table.
steps.cmd: sudo nft add rule inet filter forward ct state related,established accept

steps.explain: Allow forwarding of new connections from the client interface to the internet interface.
steps.cmd: sudo nft add rule inet filter forward iifname <CLIENT_INTERFACE> oifname <INTERNET_INTERFACE> accept

placeholders.name: CLIENT_INTERFACE
placeholders.description: Name of the interface connected to the client(s)

placeholders.name: INTERNET_INTERFACE
placeholders.description: Name of the interface connected to the internet

rollback.explain: To undo this, reboot the machine or manually delete the created table and rules using 'nft delete table inet nat' and 'nft delete rule ...'.

warnings: These rules are temporary and will be lost after a reboot.
Flushing the filter forward chain removes all forwarding rules, which might disrupt other services.
Ensure the 'filter' table and 'forward' chain exist in inet family before adding rules to them.
